categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: aviation equipment and special refrigeration. Aviation equipment includes aviation oxygen systems, onboard fuel tank inerting systems, aircraft auxiliary fuel tanks, sensitive components, and ground oxygen equipment, serving military and some civil aircraft. The special refrigeration segment covers military and civilian refrigeration equipment, including air conditioning for military vehicles, ships, and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as oxygen regulation, onboard molecular sieve oxygen generation, nitrogen separation for fuel tank inerting, and integrated oxygen supply and anti-G systems. It employs digital flexible production lines, precision manufacturing, and system integration technologies. The firm has developed proprietary technologies reaching international leading or advanced levels, supported by a comprehensive R&D system and specialized testing facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military clients across all service branches (Air Force, Army, Navy, Rocket Force) and major domestic aircraft manufacturers. The company also serves civil aviation markets with oxygen and inerting systems for large civil aircraft and helicopters. Additionally, it supplies special refrigeration products to military and industrial sectors, as well as emerging markets like aerospace and medical logistics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated within China, serving domestic military and civil aviation sectors. It has begun expanding into international markets through exports of special refrigeration products. Its manufacturing and R&D facilities are located mainly in Hefei, Anhui Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as a midstream to downstream supplier within the aerospace and defense supply chain, providing specialized core components and systems such as oxygen systems, fuel tank inerting, and auxiliary fuel tanks to aircraft manufacturers and military end-users. It also produces finished refrigeration equipment for military and industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core technology capabilities, accelerating innovation in aviation oxygen and fuel inerting systems, and expanding special refrigeration technologies. The company emphasizes digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and integrated system development. R&D efforts focus on system integration, intelligent control, lightweight materials, and expanding applications into aerospace, medical, and new military domains.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized aviation equipment and special refrigeration products to military and civil aviation customers. The company uses a direct sales model for most products, with limited use of distributors for certain civil refrigeration products. Pricing for military products follows government pricing regulations, while civil products are priced via negotiation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically as the sole specialized manufacturer of aviation oxygen systems and onboard fuel tank inerting systems, and is the largest domestic producer of aircraft auxiliary fuel tanks and a leading special refrigeration equipment manufacturer. It competes primarily within the Chinese aerospace and defense industry, with a strong technological and market position supported by its affiliation with the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC).
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, a decrease of about 10% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 125 million, down 35%. R&D investment increased to 14.72% of revenue, reflecting a focus on innovation. The company maintains a stable asset base with total assets around RMB 3.6 billion and equity of RMB 2.5 billion, indicating a medium-sized enterprise with steady but slightly declining financial performance due to market and order fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value in providing highly reliable, technologically advanced, and integrated aviation oxygen and fuel inerting systems critical for flight safety and mission success. Its products feature international leading technologies, high integration, safety, and comfort. The firm also differentiates through its comprehensive quality management, extensive testing capabilities, and strong R&D partnerships, enabling it to meet stringent military and aerospace standards and expand into emerging markets such as aerospace life support and special refrigeration for military and industrial applications.
